sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the applicability logic. The non-applicable alternative must allow category A or B ships constructed before 2017-01-01 to pass without loading-condition constraints; the current second branch instead accepts category A/B only when the date is on or after 2017-01-01, duplicating the applicable condition and causing older A/B ships to fail. Preserve the existing paired per-loading-condition alternatives: false requires residualStabilityFactorSI with inclusive numericValue bounds [1,1] and canonical unit http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS, while true requires alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true, along with the loading-case, identifier, and evidence structures.
